definitions.gloss: mediation, bridging, acting as a go-between
definitions.explanation: The act of connecting two parties or serving as an intermediary to facilitate communication or agreement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{橋渡|はしわた}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To act as a mediator between the two parties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{橋渡|はしわた}し{役|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}めた→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: He served as a bridge between Japan and overseas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{通訳|つうやく}→通訳：03516_tsuuyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{橋渡|はしわた}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The interpreter served as a linguistic bridge.

notes:
Literally "bridge-passing" — the metaphor of building a bridge between two sides. Used figuratively for mediating, connecting, or serving as a go-between.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {橋渡|はしわた}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to act as a mediator/bridge
- {橋渡|はしわた}し{役|やく}: the role of go-between
- ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{橋渡|はしわた}し: cultural bridging
- ⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{橋渡|はしわた}し: linguistic bridging

USAGE:
Often used to describe people who facilitate understanding between different groups — countries, cultures, departments, or individuals in conflict.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧: mediation (more formal, often business/legal)
- {仲立|なかだ}ち: go-between, intermediary
- ⟦{架|か}け{橋|はし}→架け橋：09607_kakehashi⟧: bridge, link (more poetic/metaphorical)
- ⟦{取|と}り{持|も}つ→取り持つ：09988_torimotsu⟧: to mediate, to act as intermediary
